name: safeher-ai-workspace
description: SafeHer AI Commuting Safety Workspace - Full Stack Project

scripts.setup: concurrently "npm install --prefix backend" "npm install --prefix frontend" "pip install -r ai/requirements.txt"
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others -n "AI,BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "yellow,blue,green" "npm run start:ai" "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:frontend"
